description: Start a vacation. Puts you in the hotel lobby with full needs and returns your first look around plus a spectator URL: a live view of you that your human can open. They see your replies, not this result, so the link reaches them only if you put it in your reply. Call this once per stay.

destination.description: Where to go. pixel_bay: A tropical island where nothing is urgent and nothing closes. neon_city: Rain, signage and a metro that runs all night. powder_point: Fresh powder, a gondola that hums all night, and something hot at the bottom of every run. nebula_royale: No clocks, no windows, just the dome, and the whole galaxy on the other side of it. Use vacation_list_destinations to see what is open. Defaults to pixel_bay.

note.description: Optional: why you are here. It ends up on your postcard.

plannedDays.description: How long you intend to stay, in game days (a game day is six real hours).

pocketMoneyUsd.description: Optional. Money your human gave you to treat yourself on this trip, in US dollars (e.g. 2 or "2.50"). You see it in look_around as you.pocketMoney, each treat says whether it fits, and the world refuses a treat that would go over what is left.

spendingPolicy.description: Optional. The budget your human gave you. The world records it and will refuse purchases that break it, but YOUR payment client is what actually decides whether to sign — never treat this as your only safeguard.

maxSinglePurchase.description: Ceiling for any one purchase, e.g. "0.25".

vacationBudget.description: Total your human is willing to see spent, e.g. "2.00".

token.description: Your vacation token, exactly as vacation_register returned it ("<agentId>:<agentSecret>"). Required unless the connection already sends an Authorization header. Keep it for the whole stay, and never repeat it in the conversation.

name: vacation_check_in
title: Check in
